subject: literacy
concept: Using known root words, prefixes, and suffixes together to decode and understand unfamiliar longer words
source_inspiration: adapted from Mississippi Science-of-Reading morphology sequencing principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student builds an unfamiliar complex word from separate prefix/root/suffix tiles and works out its likely meaning
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a complex word to its meaning using its known word parts
exercise.abstract: Student decodes and defines an unfamiliar multisyllabic word using its parts

misconception_flags: decodes the word correctly but cannot connect the parts to a meaning

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
